description: List firewall rules from the filter or nat table on a MikroTik router. Supports filtering by chain and disabled state, with pagination.

chain.description: Filter rules by chain name (e.g. forward, input, srcnat)

disabled.description: Filter by disabled state: true, false, or all

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

table.description: Firewall table to query: filter or nat

name: list_firewall_rules
title: List Firewall Rules
